'''Service Code 37-R''' was a regulation in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] that allowed [[Elara Dorne]] to obtain a position of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the Republic after her defection from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]].
